name: Blueleaf Tubers
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 5,000 experience instead of 2,100, 2.38 times as much. Read from what the game server sent in the beta. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Blueleaf tubers are a delicacy around the world!  But they're rare, very rare.  The only place to find them is here in the Barrens, deep in the earth, in Razorfen Kraul.

And even then, they're impossible to find unless you know just where to look!  That's why I've trained these snufflenose gophers to find them for me.  They have great noses and can smell a tuber from fifty paces away.

It won't be easy, but if you get me some tubers I'll pay you handsomely.
narrative.objectives:
Grab a Crate with Holes.
Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick.
Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.
narrative.offerRewardText: Great, you got them! I can sell these to my contacts for a bundle!Thanks for the delivery, adventurer! You are a great partner.
narrative.requestItemsText: Do you have the tubers, adventurer?
